blurb: Arrowood Farms is a craft brewery, distillery, and event space on 48 acres in the Hudson Valley. They craft farm-fresh beers and spirits using natural ingredients from small New York suppliers. Their kitchen offers a selection of small and big bites inspired by the local setting.
